explanation: Pointers are variables that hold memory addresses.  In C, they are crucial for dynamic memory allocation, manipulating arrays efficiently, and passing data to functions without unnecessary copying.  Understanding pointers is fundamental to mastering C programming because they provide direct access to memory locations, enabling powerful but potentially dangerous operations.
book: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie
keywords: C pointers, Memory addresses, Dereferencing, C++ pointers
